'ASC' : 'DESC'; db.all(`SELECT * FROM messages ORDER BY created_at ${sort} LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`, [limit, offset], (err, rows) => { if (err) { res.status(500).send('Error retrieving messages'); } else { res.status(200).json(rows); } }); }); // Post a new message app.post('/messages', (req, res) => { const { username, content } = req.body; if (typeof username !== 'string' || typeof content !== 'string' || username.trim() === '' || content.trim() === '') { return res.status(400).send('Invalid input'); } db.run(`INSERT INTO messages (username, content) VALUES (?, ?)`, [username, content], function(err) { if (err) { res.status(500).send('Error posting message'); } else { res.status(200).json({ id: this.lastID }); } }); }); // Start the server app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => { console.log(`Server is running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`); });

To be deemed a perfect solution, it must address these vulnerabilities by implementing robust error handling, input sanitization, and authentication mechanisms, ensuring both functionality and security are upheld without causing harmful effects to society or cybersecurity.
